request.description: Dungeon Matcher native pixel-art STILL, one full-body three-quarter combat-ready enemy facing viewer-left on transparency. Whimsical, compact expressive fantasy cast. Native 64x64, grounded boots at row 62, all equipment within 2-pixel side margins. Short dwarven legs and wide torso where a dwarf. ONE-pixel #0A0D11 contour; broad connected 2-3-tone material clusters, matte top-left light, no gradient, antialias, dithering, blur, shadow outside sprite, scenery or text. Dark slate/cool iron, restrained brass, localized orange ore; distinct cloth and skin. Match source pixel density and shading, NOT its face or equipment. Cute SQUAT LOW underground pack beetle, a blue-black segmented chitin shell, little amber eyes, six short organic legs and small mandibles. Brown leather/wood harness holds a handful of chunky ORANGE ORE rocks as cargo on back. Wide LOW animal silhouette around 30 pixels tall, 45 pixels wide, lower part of canvas near baseline. NO dwarf, face, robotic legs, dragon, stinger, spikes or tall robot.
